Definition: from a compound of G2095 and G3563; to be well- minded, i.e. reconcile:--agree.
BiblicalUsage: The word eunoéō carries the sense of agree. In Matthew 5:25, the text says "Agree with thine adversary quickly."
TheologicalSignificance: This word, eunoéō, does its job quietly — agree — and I leave it at that.
